components.name: SA-1 control flow

components.name: 65C816 decoder and lifter
components.summary: The full opcode/addressing metadata table is complete; 30 opcode semantics now execute through the runtime's lifted boundary.

metrics.label: opcode definitions
metrics.note: Definition coverage only; this does not claim verified execution semantics.

metrics.label: reference-verified semantics
metrics.note: The lifted layer now executes both complete first reset blocks, including LDA absolute, BPL, and restartable MVN.

components.name: Deterministic scheduler
components.summary: Stable master-clock event ordering exists; hardware synchronization semantics remain to be integrated.

metrics.label: synchronization classes
metrics.note: Interrupts, shared memory, DMA, timers, frames, APU ports, contention, and wait states.

components.name: S-CPU and SA-1 address spaces
components.summary: Synthetic mapping contracts cover the primary memories, mirrors, permissions, placeholders, and independent open-bus state.

metrics.label: synthetic mapping groups
metrics.note: WRAM, IRAM, BWRAM, ROM, hardware placeholders, permissions, and open bus. Hardware-reference verification remains separate.

components.name: PPU, DMA, APU, input, and save
components.summary: Reset-time general DMA and WRAM ports are implemented and tested; PPU, APU, input, and save integration remain.

components.name: Differential validator
components.summary: Reset blocks pass and the deterministic first-frame oracle is captured; native first-frame state/event comparison remains the active gate.

metrics.label: passing required scenarios
metrics.note: Seed suite only; route inventory expands with discovered behavior.

components.name: Windows package
components.summary: The Windows C++ runtime and tests build cleanly; packaging and gameplay execution remain outstanding.
